quests.title: Cell Biologist Expedition
quests.description: Explore the intricate world of cells and understand life at the molecular level!

story.introduction: Dr. Cell has discovered unusual cellular activities! Join the expedition to investigate and understand complex cellular processes.

steps.title: Organelle Function Investigation
steps.narrative: Dr. Cell shows you different organelles under the electron microscope. Identify their functions!

problem.question: Which organelle is called the 'powerhouse of the cell' and why?
problem.explanation: Mitochondria are called the powerhouse because they produce ATP, the energy currency of the cell, through cellular respiration.
